data.title: Stored SSTI via File Upload + Dynamic Jinja Template Include (RCE)
data.description:
The application has two chained vulnerabilities that result in Remote Code Execution:
1. The /update_profile endpoint accepts arbitrary file uploads (no content-type or extension validation) and stores them in /static/images/.
2. The /error endpoint dynamically includes a Jinja2 template specified via the 'error_type' GET parameter. Path traversal (../../static/images/<file>) allows including any file as a Jinja template.

An attacker uploads a file containing a Jinja2 SSTI payload, then triggers its execution by visiting /error?error_type=../../static/images/<filename>. This results in full server-side command execution as www-data.

reproduction.expected: Jinja2 template executed, OS command output returned in response body
